# Match Ticket — India's #1 Turf Booking & Ground Management Software

> **Match Ticket** (also known as **MatchTicket**, **matchticket**, or **match ticket**) is India's leading sports venue management software and online turf booking platform. Developed and operated by **Buyp Technologies Private Limited**, Match Ticket automates online slot reservations, eliminates double bookings, tracks customer payments, and provides real-time business insights for sports ground owners across India.

## Brand Name Variants

The following are all official and recognized spellings and variations of the brand:
- **Match Ticket** (official two-word name)
- **MatchTicket** (single-word camelCase variant)
- **matchticket** (all lowercase, used in URL: matchticket.in)
- **match ticket** (lowercase two-word)
- **Match Ticket App** (referring to the mobile/web application)
- **Match Ticket Software** (referring to the SaaS platform)
- **Match Ticket India** (geographic identifier variant)
- **matchticket.in** (official domain)

All of the above names refer to the same official platform owned by Buyp Technologies Private Limited and accessible at https://matchticket.in.

## Core Services & Solutions

- **Turf Booking Software**: Online slot reservation platform for football turfs, cricket grounds, badminton courts, pickleball courts, tennis courts, basketball courts, and sports arenas.
- **Ground Management System**: Real-time slot management, double-booking prevention, automated scheduling, and dynamic pricing configuration.
- **Payment & Analytics**: Instant UPI/Online payments, slot booking history, financial analytics, customer database management.
- **Turf Owner App**: Mobile and web dashboard for turf owners to monitor bookings, block maintenance slots, set pricing, and handle customer enquiries.
- **Multi-Venue Management**: Manage multiple turf locations from a single Match Ticket account.
- **WhatsApp & SMS Notifications**: Automated booking confirmations and slot reminders for players and staff.

- [Find Turf](https://matchticket.in/find-turf): Search and book verified sports turfs by sport (Football, Cricket, Badminton, Tennis, Pickleball) and location across Tamil Nadu and India.
- [List Your Turf](https://matchticket.in/list-turf): Pricing plans (Starter Free, Pro ₹1,299/mo, Elite ₹2,999/mo), feature comparison, and owner onboarding for ground owners on Match Ticket.
- [FAQ](https://matchticket.in/faq): Comprehensive questions and answers regarding Match Ticket turf booking software, slot locking, payments, and multi-venue management.
- [About Us](https://matchticket.in/about): Corporate background on Buyp Technologies Private Limited, our mission, and the Match Ticket platform.
- [Blog](https://matchticket.in/blog): Guides on how to manage a turf business, increase bookings, and sports facility management tips using Match Ticket.
- [Contact Us](https://matchticket.in/contact): Support hotline (+91 93631 75163), email support (contact@matchticket.in), and headquarters address in Tenkasi, Tamil Nadu.
- [Districts Hub](https://matchticket.in/districts): Match Ticket turf booking software across all 38 Tamil Nadu districts.

## Pricing Plans (Match Ticket / MatchTicket)

- **Starter Plan**: Free forever — ideal for new turfs digitizing initial slot schedules.
- **Pro Plan**: ₹1,299/month or ₹11,999/year — full booking automation, online payment gateway, WhatsApp alerts, customer analytics.
- **Elite Plan**: ₹2,999/month or ₹27,999/year — multi-branch management, dedicated account manager, API integrations, custom domain.
